title: Flash is now the default model
summary: LemonSlice Flash, our fastest real-time avatar model, is now the default on every plan and aspect ratio. No code changes needed.
body_markdown:
Flash, our fastest model, is now the default for every avatar on every plan. Every session gets Flash's lower latency — no configuration change required.


## What changes


Flash responds about 200–300ms faster than our previous default, LemonSlice 2.1. In our April 2026[benchmarks](https://lemonslice.com/blog/lemonslice-flash) , it reached a 471ms time-to-first-byte and ~2s end-to-end response times when paired with third-party speech-to-text, LLM and text-to-speech. Faster LLM and speech models available today reduce perceived latency even further.


Flash used to be limited to Ultra and Enterprise plans and to 2:3 avatars. It now runs on every plan, in every aspect ratio, at 24 fps.


## Do I need to change anything?


No. Sessions that don't set` model` now run Flash. If your code passes` model: "flash"` , it keeps working and gets the same default model, so you can remove it whenever it's convenient.
